properties.name: Surface NixOS host
properties.description: Surface Pro 8 system flake: ~56 configuration_*.nix modules. LUKS+USB-keyfile, btrfs subvol autocreate + impermanence (root tmpfs), KDE Plasma 6, linux-surface kernel.

properties.name: host system-protection
properties.description: configuration_system-protection{,-battery,-disk,-storage}.nix + session_isolation + rescue + hibernate/swap guards + kernel_preservation — desktop mirror of the cloud vm-pilot resilience layers.

properties.name: impermanence + btrfs
properties.description: configuration_persistence + btrfs_subvols_autocreate + pool_witness + home_ownership_repair — root is tmpfs; /nix + /home are persistent subvolumes.

properties.name: bootloader engine
properties.description: Owns ALL boot (NixOS yields). render-refind-conf/render-grub-cfg/render-nvram emit firmware config FROM nix-store generations → multi-boot (NixOS+Debian-rescue+Kali+Windows+Ventoy). adapters/nixos (nixos_yield, swap_hibernate, hardware_bootloader_boot).

properties.name: home-manager desktop
properties.description: 153-module HM flake: modules/ai (claude/gemini/ant), browsers (brave/firefox/qute), build-tools, containers-cloud, cloud-network-wg-{dns,public}, app_especific (konsole/vscode/rclone). Source of THIS CLAUDE.md (dotfiles/claude).

properties.name: home-manager termux
properties.description: nix-on-droid HM: wireguard.nix + wireguard-wstunnel.nix (WG-over-TCP/443), node-npm-deps-{cloud,front}, guard hooks (c-pretool-guard-blockers/warning), pinned autoPatchelf pkgs (claude-code, octocode, goose, ant), mcp.json.tpl→~/.mcp.json.

properties.name: unix ship engine
properties.description: build.sh switch|boot|test|build|burn. unix-ship-repo-workflow-engine + libs (engine-traps, ensure-deps, inject-header). Builds/activates host+HM; bootable artefacts (iso/qcow/vm).

properties.name: fido2-vault-broker (Rust)
properties.description: Software FIDO2 authenticator: UHID device (uhid_dev) + CTAP2 (ctap2 COSE-P256), resident keys in Bitwarden (store/bw_api+bw_keystore) TPM-sealed (store/tpm_seal). Wired via configuration_fido2-vault-broker.nix.

properties.name: waydroid apps + sensors
properties.description: Android-in-a-container app layout (gen-layout-sql) + a sensors bridge package.

properties.name: cloud Android super-apps

properties.name: rescue + fallback media
